counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with heading-bounded functional segments. All 24 PDF pages are retained because PDF page 1 contains the title and five-paragraph abstract, PDF pages 2-16 contain the argument, PDF pages 17-23 expose executable and tabular evidence, and PDF page 24 contains the source-family record. Mechanical prose counts exclude running headers, standalone equation labels, and identifiable figure captions, then are reconciled against all four rendered contact sheets before schema-v3 use.
ambiguities: Our Approach begins at the foot of PDF page 2 and continues onto page 3, so it is measured separately from both the domain introduction and the formal model chapter.
The paper labels only the opening context as Introduction; problem-analysis and approach are separated functionally because they perform distinct reader-facing jobs.

Model-establishment contains consequences, strengths, and weaknesses after each model; these repeated evaluative blocks remain in the model chapter because they motivate the next rung of the model ladder.
Results and decision-recommendation overlap on PDF page 12 but are separated by the visible 3.4 Solutions heading.

The appendix combines seven pages of code, geometry figures, scenario tables, and summary equations; prose paragraph counts underrepresent its evidence density, so formula and visual counts are reconciled directly from rendered pages.
